text: dsh-taskboard-epic 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的 Epic 关系面板，通过侧栏入口把 dsh-taskboard 工作区中的 Epic 卡片和模块对话按既有顺序呈现。它读取看板状态与工作区数据，显示模块位置、名称、版本和状态，并以关系图展示模块间的协作连接。用户可以拖动或按钮调整模块顺序、补充关系说明；排序会写回任务看板。面板还会定时刷新，并可自动归并同模块的新版本对话。使用前需安装 dsh-taskboard；不需要额外 API Key。

dsh-taskboard-epic adds a DSH web panel for Epic cards and module conversations. It groups modules, shows order and status, and visualizes collaboration links. Reorder modules by dragging or buttons, then save the order to dsh-taskboard. Requires dsh-taskboard; no API key.
想把任务看板里的 Epic 模块和对话按顺序整理出来。
有没有办法拖动模块来调整项目推进顺序，并保存到看板？
I want to see how project modules relate and edit their order from a DSH panel.
dsh-taskboard-epic 的功能「Epic 模块编排」：面板把 Epic 下的对话按模块分组并展示状态和顺序。用户可拖动或使用按钮调整模块位置，插件将新顺序写回任务看板。
dsh-taskboard-epic 的功能「模块关系图」：面板用图形呈现模块间的协作关系，并允许添加、编辑或删除带类型和说明的连接，保存到 Epic 卡片。
dsh-taskboard-epic 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 22 天；提交数 2；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-taskboard-epic README · dsh-taskboard-epic：Epic panel for **DeepSeek Harness**. It stacks the `[总任务]` (epic) cards of a
dsh-taskboard project in their `epic:children` order and lets the order of the
module arcs be rearranged by drag or by buttons.

dsh-taskboard-epic README · dsh-taskboard-epic：The panel is client-only: it reads the taskboard's public same-origin API
(`/dsh-taskboard/state`, `/dsh-taskboard/tasks/:id/update`) and renders into the
`sidebar.panellist` and `main` slots. There is no host-side state and no new
route, so the host half of this package intentionally does nothing.

dsh-taskboard-epic README · What it does：- Groups the cards of one epic into a stack, ordered by `epic:children`.
- Shows each module's position, code, name and version on the arc.
- Reorders the arc by dragging a module or by using the move buttons; the new
  order is written back to the taskboard through its public update API.
- Marks the start module, the middle modules and the end module of the arc, so
  the dependency shape of a project is visible at a glance.

dsh-taskboard-epic README · Requirements：- `dsh-taskboard` (the taskboard plugin) must be installed; the panel renders
  data that the taskboard exposes.
- A browser client (the panel is a web-client plugin).

dsh-taskboard-epic README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin add https://github.com/zirscard/dsh-taskboard-epic
```

Or from a local directory:

```bash
dsh plugin add link:/path/to/plugins/dsh-taskboard-epic
```

Restart DSH and open the Plugins page; the epic panel appears next to the
installed taskboard.

dsh-taskboard-epic README · Layout：```text
dsh-taskboard-epic/
├── index.js        # host half (intentionally a no-op; the panel is client-side)
├── client.js       # client half: data fetch, epic parsing, rendering
├── cordis.patch.yml

dsh-taskboard-epic README · Test：The repository ships a small harness that renders the panel against a fixture
tree and asserts the produced order and the reorder round-trip:

```bash
node tests/harness.mjs
```

dsh-taskboard-epic README · Notes：- The panel writes only through the taskboard's own update endpoint; it never
  edits project data directly.
- Card ordering is stored on the epic card itself, so the order survives a
  restart and is shared by everyone looking at the same project.

dsh-taskboard-epic README · English summary：`dsh-taskboard-epic` is a client-side panel for DeepSeek Harness. It stacks the
epic cards of a dsh-taskboard project in their `epic:children` order, shows each
module's position, code, name and version along the arc, and marks the start,
middle and end modules. The order can be changed by drag or by buttons, and the
new order is written back through the taskboard's public update API, so it
persists and is shared across everyone viewing the project.
